name: Volumetric Branching
description: A branching network grown by space colonization, drawn as a solid.

inputParameters.name: bounds
inputParameters.description: The box to fill. Required: there is no starting shape.

inputParameters.name: root
inputParameters.description: Where growth starts. Defaults to the middle of the floor of the box.

inputParameters.name: attractors
inputParameters.description: Points competing to be reached; more is denser. Defaults to 800.

inputParameters.name: step
inputParameters.description: Length of one growth step, in mm. Defaults to 3.5.

inputParameters.name: influence
inputParameters.description: How far a tip can be pulled from, in mm. Defaults to 22.

inputParameters.name: thin
inputParameters.description: Radius of the finest twig, in mm. Defaults to 1.5.

inputParameters.name: thick
inputParameters.description: Radius of the trunk, in mm. Defaults to 5.

inputParameters.name: seed
inputParameters.description: Which variation. Change it for another result with the same character.

inputParameters.name: run
inputParameters.description: False holds the last result while you change things upstream. Unwired, it runs.

outputParameters.name: result
outputParameters.description: The result: a volumetric object to combine, run another process on, or mesh.

outputParameters.name: history
outputParameters.description: How it was made, one operation per line.
